_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::sti#3 and the execution that FALSIFIED its Signal. There is no parse-time field check: DESIGN SURF NEUMANN, DESIGN SURF THERMO NEUMANN and DESIGN SURF TRANSPORT NEUMANN CONDITIONS are all valid section names, and none is rejected when the file is read. Moving the upstream STI deck's unprefixed DESIGN SURF NEUMANN CONDITIONS block to the THERMO spelling parses, runs, and only then dies mid-solve with 'The NUMDOF you have entered in your TRANSPORT NEUMANN CONDITION does not equal the number of scalars.' from scatra_ele/4C_scatra_ele_boundary_calc.cpp — a message that says TRANSPORT although the section said THERMO, because the thermo field is itself a scatra discretisation. Moving it to the TRANSPORT spelling is worse: the run completes normally with no diagnostic whatsoever and 24 of its 40 result tests wrong. The quoted 'condition does not apply to this field' appears nowhere. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: The NUMDOF you have entered in your TRANSPORT NEUMANN CONDITION does not equal the number of scalars.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the TRANSPORT arm: leave the section unprefixed. The load reaches the field it did before, every result test passes, EXIT_TRANSPORT becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/^DESIGN SURF NEUMANN CONDITIONS:/DESIGN SURF TRANSPORT NEUMANN CONDITIONS:/' "$BASE" > "$TMP/transport.yaml"

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the THERMO arm: leave the section unprefixed. The NUMDOF diagnostic vanishes and EXIT_THERMO becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/^DESIGN SURF NEUMANN CONDITIONS:/DESIGN SURF THERMO NEUMANN CONDITIONS:/'    "$BASE" > "$TMP/thermo.yaml"
